**All bugs fixed and tests pass.**

I identified and fixed three bugs in the apb_regs module:

1. **CTRL bit 3 masking** (line 64): The reserved bit 3 must always be 0. Fixed by changing `ctrl <= pwdata[7:0]` to `ctrl <= {pwdata[7:4], 1'b0, pwdata[2:0]}`, which masks out bit 3 on every write.

2. **INT_STATUS priority formula** (line 67): When a hardware event and software write-1-to-clear occur on the same bit in the same cycle, the set must win. Fixed by changing `(int_status | hw_event) & ~w1c_mask` to `(int_status & ~w1c_mask) | hw_event`, which ensures the event takes precedence.

3. **STATUS[5] calculation** (line 79): STATUS[5] should reflect the actual interrupt request `irq = |(INT_STATUS & INT_EN)`, not just `|int_status`. Fixed by changing the STATUS read to use the `irq` signal directly instead of `|int_status`.

All tests pass successfully.
